comparison_convention: change_percent = 100 * (compared/reference - 1); positive time is slower, negative memory is lower

correctness.fingerprint_kind: Full numeric FNV-1a64; widths, heights, bands and bit depths also compared
notes: Caps are successful demonstrations, not minimum heaps.
Both failed AUTO attempts remain byte-for-byte in the archive.
Correctness timing fields are incidental and excluded from performance comparisons.
FAST controls use the same frozen final runtime, not an older release.
Warnings count only CR3 low-memory messages; separate SLF4J diagnostics are retained.

default-control-measurements.sampling: Median of process medians; each process peak RSS includes warmups and VM overhead

default-craw-rss-confirmation.interpretation: The initial high final-variant RSS/heap excursions did not recur in these five follow-up processes. Their cause was not isolated, and this result does not establish a universal RAM bound. Time values in this panel are retained diagnostics for the RSS investigation.
default-craw-rss-confirmation.purpose: Targeted RSS confirmation after the original default-control panel showed a G5 X II C-RAW process-peak RSS increase and transient larger post-import heap observations. Five fresh forks retain the original three-warmup/five-measured-import protocol. The original panel remains unchanged and the two panels are not pooled. The allocation control differed by only eight bytes per import; the cause of the heap/RSS excursions is unresolved. Output fingerprints and allocation totals alone do not establish a collector diagnosis or extra per-import pixel work.
default-craw-rss-confirmation.sampling: Median of process medians; each process peak RSS includes warmups and VM overhead

default-g5-confirmation.purpose: Targeted confirmation after the original three-fork default-control panel showed a G5 RAW slowdown. This five-fork panel uses eight warmups and twelve measured imports per process. The original panel and all its forks remain retained; the two protocols are not pooled.
default-g5-confirmation.sampling: Median of process medians; each process peak RSS includes warmups and VM overhead
